prices.source: cloud.google.com/run/pricing, request-based billing (CPU only during requests), Tier 1 regions (us-east4) as known 2026; the free tier is per billing account. Check before relying on them.

light.name: gen-cpu
light.why: seconds-long image and probe work: a small instance serves several at once, so a burst of resizes costs one instance

heavy.name: gen-cpu-heavy
heavy.why: cutouts (BiRefNet), video encodes and splats want every core; one request per instance makes each job's seconds its own and its cost exact
